# E0240: the lineage has no schema with that version

A schema was asked for by a version the lineage does not have. The help lists
the versions it does.

## Example

`lineage.cue`:

```cue
name: "ship"
schemas: {
	"0": {
		"0": {
			schema: {
				a: string
			}
		}
	}
}
```

thema reports:

```
error[E0240]: lineage ship has no schema 9.9
  |
  = help: its versions are 0.0
```
